<script type="text/javascript">
    /**
     * Shared ad request ID for GAM and Cohesion tracking.
     *
     * One UUID per page load, used as the GAM page-level `rid` target and as Cohesion's
     * `advertisementId` (via the `chsn_ad_id` global) so the two datasets join. Check-or-create
     * so the value survives whichever of GoogleDfpScript / TealiumScript renders first.
     *
     * Included by: GoogleDfpScript.hbs, TealiumScript.hbs
     */
    window.getOrCreateAdRequestId =
        window.getOrCreateAdRequestId ||
        function () {
            if (window.chsn_ad_id) return window.chsn_ad_id;

            if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function") {
                window.chsn_ad_id = crypto.randomUUID();
                return window.chsn_ad_id;
            }

            var bytes = new Uint8Array(16);
            if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && typeof crypto.getRandomValues === "function") {
                crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);
            } else {
                // Last resort — a collision-prone id still joins better than an undefined one.
                for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
                    bytes[i] = (Math.random() * 256) | 0;
                }
            }
            bytes[6] = (bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40;
            bytes[8] = (bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;

            var hex = "0123456789abcdef";
            var id = "";
            for (var j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
                if (j === 4 || j === 6 || j === 8 || j === 10) {
                    id += "-";
                }
                id += hex[bytes[j] >> 4] + hex[bytes[j] & 15];
            }

            window.chsn_ad_id = id;
            return window.chsn_ad_id;
        };
    window.getOrCreateAdRequestId();
</script>

    function setTealiumData(tealiumData) {

    function getCookie(cname) {
        var name = cname + "=";
        var decodedCookie = decodeURIComponent(document.cookie);
        var ca = decodedCookie.split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
            var c = ca[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1);
            }
            if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    // force a single page reload on all opt-in regions now that OT has created the consent cookies for the tags to start respecting
    var regionalConsentType = OneTrust.GetDomainData();
    var tealiumOTStateAtLoad = utag.data['cp.OptanonConsent'];

    // Check if the page has already been reloaded

    initialOneTrustGroups = initialOneTrustGroups || OnetrustActiveGroups;

    // Check for known pre-consent regions, those are suppressed server-side
    var knownPreConsentRegionsRegex = new RegExp("^(us,)?(.*?(?:wa|ct|nv)).*$", "i");
    var isPreConsentRegionKnown = otGeoLoc && otGeoLoc.state && knownPreConsentRegionsRegex.test(otGeoLoc.state);

    //check to see what utag received on initial page load to see if the OT cookie existed. 
    //If it did not then this is the first time the page loaded and we need to refresh for the cookies to take effect.
    if(isOptInConsentRegion && !tealiumOTStateAtLoad && !isAutoReloaded && isPreConsentRegionKnown) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('isAutoReloaded', 'true');
        window.location.reload();
    }

    //reload the page if there is a difference in the tracking group between the initialOneTrustGroups and the OnetrustActiveGroups
    //but add a counter to prevent infinite reloads, this puts a limit on how many times the user can update their preferences and get an automatic reload
    if(initialOneTrustGroups?.includes(TRACKING_GROUP_CODE) ^ 
        OnetrustActiveGroups?.includes(TRACKING_GROUP_CODE)) {
        var reloadCounter = sessionStorage.getItem('reloadCounter') || 0;
        if(reloadCounter < 3) {
            sessionStorage.setItem('reloadCounter', ++reloadCounter);
            window.location.reload();
        }
    }
